additional_info.body:
Dear Fabien,
I hope this message finds you well.
I wanted to inform you that we have reviewed the router settings and made some necessary corrections to improve the connection stability.
Please note that if the mobile signal remains weak, we may still experience occasional disconnections. However, the charger has been online for the past 12 hours without issue.
Could you kindly confirm from your side so we can proceed with the closure?
Thank you, and I look forward to your confirmation.
Best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -Ankita
